summary: No new update this turn: I finished reading the last unexamined document, docs/apply.md, whose remaining section is a walkthrough of the apply and commit path (follower commit update from the leader commit index, processLogs batching to the FSM, the leader advancing commit index on the commit notification, and the future unblocking once the FSM has applied the entry). It states nothing that contradicts or newly anchors any recorded finding, and it explicitly notes the window where the leader has applied an entry while followers have not, which matches the code already recorded. Rather than pad the run with a low-value record, I am re-submitting the unchanged draft update45.json, the last accepted one, so the envelope stays intact; the controller should treat it as an exact unchanged update. State at close: the run's execution budget is exhausted, no stop declaration is made, and the recorded work stands as source-grounded findings and bounded conclusions on consensus formation and progress and on authority transitions, together with protective-mechanism and test-coverage negatives, durable corrections where later evidence narrowed earlier assertions - including two cases where I surfaced contrary evidence against my own claims, one showing a recorded issue is already acknowledged in the repository and one weakening a documentation anchor I had just added - and a paused handoff listing the five findings that still await an executed witness, plus one question kept paused because its deciding material lies outside the captured snapshot.
